title: Station
description: What Soundfolk adds to a Radio-Browser station. See README.md.

name.description: The station's name, for people reading the file.

homepage.description: The station's official website, reviewed by the maintainer. Links are checked against it, never against Radio-Browser's, which anyone can edit.

match.description: Which stations the entry applies to.

Match.description: Same as the recipes' `match` (soundfolk-recipes/recipe.schema.json), except that `stations` is required.

streams.description:
Stream URLs without the scheme (`host/path`), case-insensitive. A trailing `*` matches
any path starting with what precedes it.

url.description: The donation page: on the station's own domain or a platform of platforms.toml.

found_on.description: The page of the station's website that links to `url`: the proof, checked every day.

checked_by_hand.description: Maintainer only, when the station's website doesn't link to `url`: how and when the link was checked (an e-mail from the station's address, the association registry…).
